title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: MuleSoft Anypoint
providers.scope_notes: Covers MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. Anypoint Platform control plane (US/EU/Gov); IP allowlist only US/EU commercial; audit export needs Anypoint Integration Advanced or Titanium.

controls.name: Disable connected apps for the organization
controls.what: Org admin can turn off the connected apps feature for the whole org.
controls.setting: Access Management > Connected Apps (exact setting not named in docs)

controls.name: Scopes per business group and environment
controls.what: App permissions are limited to chosen scopes, business groups and environments.
controls.setting: Access Management > Connected Apps > Add Scopes

controls.name: Client secret expiration date
controls.what: Set an expiry on the connected app client secret.

controls.name: Modify the Client Secret for a Connected App
controls.what: Admin replaces the client secret manually or via Access Management API.
controls.setting: Access Management > Connected Apps > app > Secret

controls.name: Delete Connected Application
controls.what: Deleting the app removes the client; effect on live tokens not documented.
controls.setting: Access Management > Connected Apps > Owned Apps

controls.name: Revoke org connected app tokens
controls.what: Revokes all access and refresh tokens issued to a connected app.

controls_unknown: Whether IP allowlist applies to connected app token requests or API calls with an issued token
Whether deleting a client-credentials app or rotating its secret invalidates unexpired access tokens
Whether a client-credentials app's tokens can be revoked without deleting it (Revoke Authorization is documented for user authorizations)
Exact UI setting name for disabling connected apps org-wide
Whether read/GET API calls are audit logged
Environment client secret rotation procedure (help.salesforce.com KB 001115221 did not render)
Whether IdP conditional access applies to connected app tokens (not stated)

auth_paths.name: Connected app that acts on its own behalf (client credentials)

authentication.summary: App posts client_id and client_secret to /accounts/api/v2/oauth2/token and gets a 60-minute bearer token; no user, SSO or MFA step is involved (MuleSoft points CI/CD to connected apps when enabling MFA; connected apps are exempt from reauthentication). Query results use the scope of the user who created the app.

federation.details: No inbound workload federation documented. The openid:google_wif scope is outbound: Anypoint acts as IdP for Google Cloud WIF.

ip_restriction.boundary: The org IP allowlist covers only user sign-ins with Anypoint credentials; client-credentials token requests are not user sign-ins. No per-app IP restriction documented.

lifetime.summary: 60-min access token; client secret no expiry by default, expiry settable

renewal.summary: Re-run client_credentials grant with the secret.

administration.summary: Org admins in the root org or business group create, edit, rotate secret, and delete. Scopes map to platform permissions and can be limited per business group and environment.
administration.conditions: Organization Administrator permission; up to 2000 apps per org.

offboard.details: When the creating user is deleted or removed, the app's ownership moves to the root org owner and the app keeps working; docs tell admins to rotate secrets manually.

inventory.details: Access Management > Connected Apps (Owned Apps) and GET /accounts/api/organizations/{organizationId}/connectedApplications.

log_sources.name: Anypoint Platform audit log (Access Management > Audit Log, Audit Log Query API)
log_sources.notes: Default retention 1 year (6 years for orgs before 2023-07-10), configurable 30-2190 days; export via Telemetry Exporter needs Anypoint Integration Advanced or Titanium.

credential_id_fields.notes: Object of the entry; payload has clientName, clientIP, orgID, grantTypes
Name of app that performed the action, N/A otherwise

anomaly_cues: Token Retrieval Success from new clientIP
Update Scope Assignments adding broad scopes
Actions attributed to a connected app outside its normal product area

containment.steps: Rotate the secret (Modify the Client Secret) or delete the app in Access Management > Connected Apps; remove scopes.
containment.notes: DELETE /accounts/api/organizations/{organizationId}/connectedApplications/{clientId}/revoke revokes all access and refresh tokens issued to the app. Rotating the secret alone is not documented to kill issued tokens.

incident_response.sample_query: POST /audit/v2/organizations/<orgId>/query with objectIds:["<clientID>"] and a date range

calls.log_notes: Needs Audit Log Viewer or Org Admin

unknown: Which data reads appear in audit log
